description: "History of the United Netherlands, 1588" by John Lothrop Motley is a historical account written in the late 19th century. The book chronicles the complex political and military struggles in the Netherlands during the late 16th century, focusing particularly on the events surrounding the Spanish Armada and the attempts by King Philip II of Spain to subdue the Protestant influences in Europe.
